snippet.title: SkillWarz is Coming to Steam!
snippet.description:
The game is now on Steam for wishlisting. Release date isn’t fixed yet, it depends on reaching the required amount of support. Add it to your wishlist today and help us get closer to launch!

Wishlist now on Steam: 
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3736400/SkillWarz/

Read more in our blog post:
🔗 https://baltverge.com/skillwarz-is-coming-to-steam

🎬 Trailer by Rose
https://www.youtube.com/@888roses

#skillwarz #steamgame  #indiegame
